These guys are thorough professionals. Right from hygiene, service to Products to the Experience, everything is just Bang On! Staff is well trained and polite. Overall a great experience!! Thank you so much Nanda!!!

I asked the cost they said 800 which I found it very high but had no choice as I had to leave to go out of town. When I went to pay the bill they charged me 1200. I felt cheated. They used a steel knife and charged me a premium amount. Premium brands charge this much with proper hygiene. Also it's better to opt for home service then go to an unhygienic place.
